questions.q: What is the key difference between a data asset and a data product?
options: A data product is always a Power BI report, while a data asset is always a SQL table
A data asset is a single technical item; a data product is a curated bundle of related assets built around a use case
There is no real difference — the terms are interchangeable
A data asset requires approval while a data product never does
questions.explain: A data asset is one table, file, or report; a data product packages several related assets together around a named business use case.

questions.q: Where do data products live in Purview's structure?
options: Nested inside a governance domain
Attached only to Power BI workspaces
Inside a scan rule set
Directly inside a sensitivity label
questions.explain: Data products belong to governance domains — a domain's detail page shows exactly how many data products, glossary terms, OKRs, and critical data elements it contains.

questions.q: Per the lesson's example, why does bundling tables into a single data product matter for access requests?
options: Because it removes the need for any data product owner
So a business user can request one data product instead of requesting access to many individual tables separately
Because data products never require any access request at all
Because Purview technically cannot grant access to more than one table at a time
questions.explain: Instead of requesting fifteen tables separately, a user can request one curated data product and get everything needed in a single request.

questions.q: What role does a "data product owner" play?
options: A role that only exists for glossary terms, not data products
A temporary role that expires after the product is published
An automated system account with no human assigned
The accountable contact responsible for a data product's accuracy and usefulness
questions.explain: Every well-built data product has an accountable owner listed in its Contacts panel, responsible for keeping it accurate and useful.

questions.q: How does Purview measure a data product's governance health, per the lesson?
options: By requiring a manual spreadsheet audit every quarter
Governance health is never measured for data products
Only by counting how many times the product's name appears in search
Through an automated governance score and KPI tiles (classification, ownership, connection, data-quality measurement, and more)
questions.explain: Data product details reports auto-calculate a governance score and KPI tiles like classification, ownership, connection, and data-quality measurement.
